turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email used for the order. I’ll check whether the address can still be changed.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.
I can’t change the delivery address because the order has already shipped. A colleague will take over to help with this.

rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
